abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this study is to investigate radiologic findings of struma ovarii, and to correlate both CT and MR findings. MATERIALS AND METHODS: MR images of 26 cases were retrospectively reviewed. Post-contrast enhanced T1-weighted images were available in 17 patients. CT images, including seven non-contrast and eleven post-contrast studies, were available for review in 13 cases. RESULTS: All 26 tumors appeared as well-defined cystic tumors with solid components, which were multilobulated surfaces in 19 and smooth surfaces in seven. Twenty-four was multicystic, whereas two were unilocular. The solid components were recognized as thickened septi or walls in 23 and a mass in three tumors. On T2-weighted images, loculi of prominent low intensity were recognized in 16 tumors. On T1-weighted images, the punctuate foci of high intensity were recognized in 24 tumors in or adjacent to the solid components. Ascites was present in only one lesion. In six of seven cases with non-contrast CT images, high attenuation areas were recognized. In five of these six tumors, high attenuation areas corresponded to the areas of prominent low intensity and the solid components on T2-weighted images. In seven cases with CT, curvilinear calcifications were recognized in the solid components. CONCLUSION: Struma ovarii typically presents as a lobulated multicystic lesion with solid components. The tumors frequently include loculi of low intensity on T2-weighted images and punctuate foci of high intensity on T1-weighted images. On CT, high attenuation areas and calcifications in the solid components are common findings.
abstract_ja: 目的：本研究の目的は、卵巣甲状腺腫の放射線学的所見を調べ、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見と磁気共鳴画像(MRI)所見を対比することである。対象と方法：卵巣甲状腺腫26例のMR画像を後方視的に検討した。造影後T1強調像は17例で利用可能であった。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)画像は、非造影CT 7例と造影CT 11例、計13例で評価可能であった。結果：26例すべてが、充実成分を伴う境界明瞭な囊胞性腫瘍として認められた。表面は19例で分葉状、7例で平滑であった。24例は多房性で、2例は単房性であった。充実成分は、23例で肥厚した隔壁または壁として、3例で腫瘤として認められた。T2強調像では、16例で著明な低信号の小腔が認められた。T1強調像では、24例で充実成分内またはその近傍に点状の高信号巣が認められた。非造影CT画像を有した7例のうち6例で高吸収域が認められた。これら6例のうち5例では、高吸収域はT2強調像で著明な低信号を示す部位および充実成分に一致していた。CTを行った7例では、充実成分内に曲線状の石灰化が認められた。結論：卵巣甲状腺腫は典型的には、充実成分を伴う分葉状の多房性病変として認められる。T2強調像で低信号の小腔とT1強調像で点状の高信号巣をしばしば伴う。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、充実成分内の高吸収域と石灰化が一般的な所見である。
